name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; accurately describes the function (builds the class-promotion candidate list together with each candidate's target class). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Scan the active party and build the parallel candidate-char / target-class lists for the church class-promotion menu, resolving each eligible unit's promotion target (default tier-1 upgrade, item-gated alt advanced branch, or Yuni's summoner branch).
logic_summary: count=0; for char_idx in [0, data_fd2_shared_menu_party_member_count): read runtime_char[char_idx] (stride 0x50): portrait_id at +0x07, level at +0x21. Eligible only if level>=0x14 (20) AND portrait_id<0x12 (basic classes 0..0x11) AND portrait_id!=7 (蘭斯洛特/Lancelot, no promotion path). For each eligible unit: out_chars[count]=char_idx; out_targets[count]=portrait_id+0x20 (default first-tier promotion). If the unit holds the per-class change item key_item=data_fd2_ui_per_basic_portrait_class_change_key_item_id_table[portrait_id] (table @0x526a7, byte[18]), override out_targets[count]=portrait_id+0x32 (alt advanced-tier branch). Special-case portrait_id==9 (悠妮/Yuni): if the unit holds item 0x5A (精靈契印), override out_targets[count]=0x34 (悠妮（召喚師）/Yuni Summoner). count++. Return count (byte, zero-extended).

params.name: out_chars
params.semantics: Output buffer (caller-provided byte[32]) receiving the runtime-char index of each promotion-eligible candidate, packed [0..count).
params.reason: Accurate (char-index output array); no address residue.

params.name: out_targets
params.semantics: Output buffer (caller-provided byte[32]) receiving the resolved target-class/portrait id for each candidate (portrait_id+0x20 default, portrait_id+0x32 item-gated alt, or 0x34 Yuni summoner), parallel-indexed with out_chars.
params.reason: Accurate (target-class output array); no address residue.

returns.semantics: Number of promotion-eligible candidates written (0..32). Returned as a single byte zero-extended into EAX by the epilogue; caller uses it as both a count==0 test and the candidate count for the picker.

comment_original_issue: Logic/structure description was correct, but the domain identity annotations were systematically wrong: portrait 7 was labeled '索爾/Sol main lord' (actually 蘭斯洛特/Lancelot, a fixed class with no promotion data); portrait 9 was labeled '主角/Lord candidate' (actually 悠妮/Yuni); item 0x5A was labeled 'Sword' (actually 精靈契印, Yuni's summoner class-change item); 0x34 was labeled 'Lord class direct' (actually 悠妮（召喚師）/Yuni Summoner). The +0x32 alt path is gated by the per-class change item from table @0x526a7 (e.g. Yuni's 聖者之戒 0x58 -> 聖者/Saint), not a generic 'alt promotion path'.
notes: Domain identities verified via fd2-knowledge: item 0x5A=精靈契印 (悠妮轉職召喚師物品); portrait 0x07=蘭斯洛特 (1 job entry only, spell-learn idx 0xFF = no promotion); portrait 0x09=悠妮; 0x29=悠妮（大法師）, 0x3B=悠妮（聖者）, 0x34=悠妮（召喚師）. Key-item table @0x526a7 read as 18 bytes [59 5d ff 5d cd cd cd cd 5c 58 58 58 5b 5c 58 5b ff ff]; entry[9]=0x58=聖者之戒 (僧侶、法師轉職聖者物品). Table size byte[18] matches the portrait_id<0x12 cap exactly (one key-item id per basic class). Disasm @0x31793 confirms: stride 0x50, portrait_id +0x07, level +0x21, both fd2_find_inventory_slot_with_item calls (target 0x31860) followed by ADD ESP,8 / CMP EAX,-1 (genuine slot return); count single-byte at ESP+4. Note: 0x526a7 is the key-item table address (not a function); my initial get_function_signature at 0x26a7 correctly returned 'no function'. Name + signature + param names all correct (keep). No logic/equivalence issues found.
